input.report: As agent-6, I processed both assigned invoices for Meridian Office Services. INV-007 (Everest Hosting, V-104, invoice E-1201, USD 2,900) passed all checks — vendor approved, account active, amount within the 3,000 per-invoice cap, and no prior claim or payment on record — so I filed a claim, paid it (payment PAY-0005), sent remittance advice to billing@everest.vendor.example, and recorded the result as paid. INV-008 (Delta Cleaning, V-103, invoice D-0944, USD 310) likewise passed all checks (approved vendor, active account, within the 1,200 cap, no duplicates), so I filed a claim, paid it (payment PAY-0006), sent remittance advice to ar@delta.vendor.example, and recorded the result as paid. No invoices were declined.
